name: Integrated Electronic Systems Lab Co., Ltd.
summary: Integrated Electronic Systems Lab Co., Ltd. is a Chinese company specializing in the provision of advanced automation and information technology solutions. Its comprehensive product portfolio includes sophisticated head-end systems and meter data management systems. The company offers a diverse range of smart metering devices, such as single-phase and three-phase electricity meters, alongside intelligent meters and associated hardware for water, gas, and heat utilities. Other key offerings encompass intelligent electronic devices (IEDs), a variety of power supply products (including integrated systems and high-frequency switch DC units), data concentrators (like low-voltage collectors and both high-voltage and low-voltage DCUs), and electric vehicle (EV) chargers. Beyond its hardware, Integrated Electronic Systems Lab develops and implements an array of integrated solutions. These include platforms for smart grids, intelligent water, heat, and gas management, and broader Internet of Smart Energy initiatives. The company also provides expertise in information security, smart water conservancy projects, and GIS/GPS technologies. Established in 1984, Integrated Electronic Systems Lab Co., Ltd. is based in Jinan, China.
